简单取放.title: Two-phase search-then-place decomposition for simple pick-and-place
简单取放.principle: For simple pick-and-place goals, split the mission into a SEARCH MISSION that ends when the target object is in inventory, followed by an OPERATION MISSION that ends when the environment observation confirms the object is placed at the destination.
简单取放.when_to_apply: When the goal is to put an object at a destination and the object is not already held.

简单取放.title: Search mission return condition: holding the target object
简单取放.principle: Define the SEARCH MISSION return condition as the worker holding the target object, not merely having seen it or opened a container.
简单取放.when_to_apply: When dispatching a worker to find and take an object for a simple pick-and-place task.

简单取放.title: Operation mission return condition: environment observation confirms placement
简单取放.principle: Define the OPERATION MISSION return condition as the environment observation confirming the object is at the destination, not merely that the worker attempted the put action.
简单取放.when_to_apply: When dispatching a worker to place a held object at a destination in a simple pick-and-place task.

简单取放.title: Avoid over-constraining search to a single receptacle
简单取放.principle: Do not dispatch a search mission that requires finding the object in one specific receptacle unless that receptacle is known to contain it; if the first location fails, broaden the search to other reachable receptacles.
简单取放.why_it_happens: The supervisor may assume the target is in a named container, but the environment may place it elsewhere, causing the worker to exhaust the specified location and fail.
简单取放.how_to_avoid: Phrase search missions as 'find and take X from any available receptacle' or include a fallback instruction to search other containers if the first location does not contain the target.

台灯观察.title: Two-phase search-then-operate decomposition for 台灯观察
台灯观察.principle: For 台灯观察 tasks, first dispatch a SEARCH MISSION to locate and take the target object, then after HANDOFF dispatch an OPERATION MISSION to bring the object to the desklamp and perform the examine/look interaction.
台灯观察.when_to_apply: When the goal is to examine or look at a movable object with/under a desklamp and the object is not already in inventory.

台灯观察.title: Use desklamp as a fixed fixture, not a takeable object
台灯观察.principle: In 台灯观察 tasks, the desklamp is typically fixed to its surface. Do not dispatch a mission to take the desklamp; instead, dispatch a mission to go to the desklamp's location and use it (turn it on) while holding the target object.
台灯观察.when_to_apply: When the goal requires examining or looking at an object with/under the desklamp and the desklamp is observed on a desk, sidetable, or dresser.

台灯观察.title: Avoid repeated examine/look loops on the same object
台灯观察.principle: Repeatedly dispatching examine or look missions for the same object after the environment has already returned 'There's nothing special about X' or 'Nothing happens' causes handoff loops and task failure. After one or two failed examine attempts, change strategy: verify object location, try a different interaction (take/put/use), or declare failure.
台灯观察.when_to_apply: When a worker returns HANDOFF after an examine/look action that produced no meaningful observation, or when the same examine mission has been dispatched more than once.

台灯观察.title: Do not assume target object is under the desklamp without verification
台灯观察.principle: The phrase 'under the desklamp' in 台灯观察 goals does not guarantee the target object is physically under the lamp. If the object is not visible at the desklamp location, search other surfaces and containers before declaring failure. Dispatching repeated 'look under desklamp' missions when the object is elsewhere wastes steps and causes failure.
台灯观察.when_to_apply: When the target object is not observed at the desklamp location after an initial search, or when examine/look actions at the desklamp return 'Nothing happens'.

清洗后放置.title: Clean-then-place pipeline with explicit clean-state verification
清洗后放置.principle: For 清洗后放置 tasks, decompose into: (1) locate and take the target object, (2) go to a sinkbasin and clean it, (3) verify the clean confirmation in the observation, (4) go to the destination and place it. Do not skip the clean step or assume cleaning succeeded without an explicit 'You clean the X' observation.
清洗后放置.when_to_apply: Any 清洗后放置 goal where the target object may be dirty and the destination is a fixed receptacle.

清洗后放置.title: Do not dispatch a search mission for an object at a location that has not been observed to contain it
清洗后放置.why_it_happens: The supervisor issues a SEARCH MISSION naming a specific receptacle (e.g., 'go to sinkbasin 1 and take soapbar') based on the goal template rather than on observed environment state. When the receptacle is empty or contains a different object, the worker cannot satisfy the RETURN WHEN condition and the episode fails.
清洗后放置.how_to_avoid: Before dispatching a search mission, require the worker to first report the contents of candidate receptacles, or phrase the mission as 'search cabinets/drawers/countertops for X' rather than binding to a specific unverified location. If the first search returns empty, reassign a broader search instead of repeating the same location.

清洗后放置.title: Do not dispatch a placement mission to a closed or non-openable receptacle without first opening it
清洗后放置.why_it_happens: The supervisor assigns an OPERATION MISSION to put an object into a receptacle (e.g., coffeemachine, toilet, drawer) that is closed or does not support opening. The worker repeatedly attempts 'put' and 'open' with 'Nothing happens' observations, exhausting steps and failing.
清洗后放置.how_to_avoid: Before dispatching a placement mission, verify the destination is open or can be opened. If the destination is a closed container, prepend an open step. If opening returns 'Nothing happens', treat the receptacle as non-openable and reassign to a valid open destination.

清洗后放置.title: Do not declare success or failure based on worker handoff text alone; require environment confirmation of the final state
清洗后放置.why_it_happens: The supervisor sometimes declares FAILED after a worker HANDOFF even when the environment events show the object was successfully placed (e.g., episode_043, episode_046, episode_051, episode_058, episode_067, episode_073). Conversely, it may accept a handoff without verifying the clean state or final placement.
清洗后放置.how_to_avoid: After each OPERATION MISSION handoff, inspect the environment observation for the target object's final state (e.g., 'You put the X in/on Y' or 'You clean the X'). Only declare success when the observation confirms the goal predicate; only declare failure when the observation shows an invalid/blocked action or the object is unreachable.

加热后放置.title: Search mission for heat-and-place tasks
加热后放置.principle: For heat-and-place tasks, dispatch a SEARCH MISSION to locate and take the target object from plausible receptacles. Return when the worker reports holding the object.
加热后放置.when_to_apply: At initial dispatch when the target object is not already held.

加热后放置.title: Heat mission after object acquisition
加热后放置.principle: After the worker returns holding the target object, dispatch an OPERATION MISSION to heat it using a heat source such as microwave 1. Return when the environment confirms the object is heated.
加热后放置.when_to_apply: After a successful SEARCH MISSION handoff where the worker holds the target object.

加热后放置.title: Placement mission after heating
加热后放置.principle: After the worker returns with the object heated, dispatch an OPERATION MISSION to place it at the specified destination. Return when the environment confirms the object is at the destination.
加热后放置.when_to_apply: After a successful HEAT MISSION handoff where the object is heated.

加热后放置.title: Avoid repeated invalid heat/put loops
加热后放置.principle: If the worker repeatedly reports 'Nothing happens' for heat or put actions, do not dispatch another identical heat/put variant for the same target. Instead, change strategy by verifying object location, opening the appliance, or switching to a different heat source or placement approach.
加热后放置.why_it_happens: The object may not be inside the appliance, the appliance may be closed, or the action may be invalid in the current state.
加热后放置.how_to_avoid: After one or two failed identical attempts, dispatch a SEARCH or VERIFY mission to confirm the object's location and appliance state before retrying heat or put.

冷却后放置.title: Cooling requires a dedicated cool action, not just fridge placement
冷却后放置.principle: For cooling tasks, after obtaining the target object, explicitly perform the cool action with the fridge (e.g., 'cool X with fridge 1') before attempting to place it. Do not assume that putting the object into the fridge and taking it out constitutes cooling.
冷却后放置.when_to_apply: When the goal is to cool an object and place it elsewhere, and the object is currently held.

冷却后放置.title: Avoid repeated put/take cycles with the cooling appliance
冷却后放置.principle: Do not repeatedly put the object into the fridge and take it out as a substitute for the cool action. This wastes steps and often fails to produce the cooled state.
冷却后放置.why_it_happens: The agent may misinterpret the cooling requirement as a simple placement task or may be unsure how to trigger the cool action.
冷却后放置.how_to_avoid: After taking the object, go to the fridge and use the explicit cool action. If the cool action is unavailable, verify the object is coolable and the fridge is open.

冷却后放置.title: Verify object identity and coolability before committing to a search
冷却后放置.principle: Before dispatching a search for a specific object, confirm that the object type is present and coolable. If the object is not found after a reasonable search, consider that the task may be impossible and report failure early.
冷却后放置.why_it_happens: The supervisor may assume the object exists without checking, leading to exhaustive searches that waste time and end in failure.
冷却后放置.how_to_avoid: During initial exploration, note the locations of objects. If the target object is not found in likely receptacles, reassess the task feasibility.

冷却后放置.title: Ensure destination receptacle is open before placing
冷却后放置.principle: Before attempting to place the cooled object into a cabinet or other closed receptacle, ensure the receptacle is open. If it is closed, open it first.
冷却后放置.when_to_apply: When the goal is to place the object into a cabinet, drawer, or other openable receptacle.

双物品放置.title: Sequential two-item placement with single-item capacity
双物品放置.principle: For 双物品放置 tasks, treat the mission as two independent search-and-place cycles: locate and take the first target object, place it at the destination, then locate and take the second target object and place it at the destination.
双物品放置.when_to_apply: When the goal requires placing two instances of the same object type at a destination and the worker can hold only one object at a time.

双物品放置.title: Search mission return condition must include holding the object
双物品放置.principle: A SEARCH MISSION for a takeable object should return only when the worker reports holding the target object, not merely when the object has been observed or found.
双物品放置.when_to_apply: When dispatching a worker to find and take an object for a 双物品放置 task.

双物品放置.title: Avoid repeated identical search dispatches after worker failure
双物品放置.principle: If a worker returns HANDOFF without the target object or reports failure, do not re-dispatch the same search mission to the same location; change the search location, object description, or strategy.
双物品放置.why_it_happens: The supervisor may repeat the same ASSIGN when the worker's failure is not treated as evidence that the current search plan is exhausted.
双物品放置.how_to_avoid: After a failed or empty search, dispatch the next candidate location or ask the worker to confirm the location is empty before moving on.

双物品放置.title: Do not dispatch placement before the worker holds the object
双物品放置.principle: An OPERATION MISSION to put an object at the destination should be dispatched only after the worker has confirmed holding that object; otherwise the placement action will fail or be invalid.
双物品放置.why_it_happens: The supervisor may issue a placement mission based on the intended object rather than the worker's actual inventory state.
双物品放置.how_to_avoid: Require the worker's HANDOFF to explicitly report holding the target object before assigning the corresponding placement mission.

简单取放.title: Search visible surfaces before opening containers
简单取放.principle: For simple pick-and-place tasks, first scan all visible surfaces (tables, desks, dressers, beds, shelves, countertops, sofas, armchairs, etc.) for the target object before opening closed containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves.
简单取放.when_to_apply: When the target object is not immediately visible in the current location and the task is a simple pick-and-place.

简单取放.title: Open closed containers before attempting to take from them
简单取放.principle: When a target object is expected inside a closed container (drawer, cabinet, safe, fridge, microwave), first navigate to the container, then use the open action, then take the object from the opened container.
简单取放.when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible on surfaces and a closed container is a likely location.

简单取放.title: After taking the target object, navigate to the destination and put it there
简单取放.principle: Once the target object is in inventory, go directly to the specified destination receptacle or surface and use the put action to place the object there.
简单取放.when_to_apply: After successfully taking the target object and before declaring handoff or completion.

简单取放.title: Avoid repeated failed actions and declare blocked after exhaustive search
简单取放.principle: If an action such as go to or open returns 'Nothing happens' repeatedly, do not keep retrying the same action. After checking all plausible locations and containers without finding the target object, declare the task blocked rather than looping.
简单取放.when_to_apply: When repeated navigation or open actions fail, or when all known containers and surfaces have been searched without finding the target object.

台灯观察.title: 台灯观察：先定位目标物，再将其带到台灯处并开启台灯
台灯观察.principle: 对于“look at/examine X under the desklamp”类任务，先搜索并取得目标物 X；若目标物不在台灯所在位置，则将其带到有 desklamp 的桌面/台面，放置或保持持有，然后使用 desklamp 开启照明，以完成观察条件。
台灯观察.when_to_apply: 任务目标为观察某物在台灯下，且环境中存在可交互的 desklamp；目标物与 desklamp 不在同一位置，或目标物需要从其他容器/表面取得。

台灯观察.title: 台灯观察：desklamp 通常不可拿取，应使用而非 take
台灯观察.principle: 在台灯观察任务中，desklamp 通常是固定物体，take desklamp 会返回“Nothing happens.”；正确交互是 use desklamp 来开启它，或把目标物放到 desklamp 所在表面后再 use desklamp。
台灯观察.when_to_apply: 需要与 desklamp 交互时；若 take desklamp 失败，不要反复尝试拿取，应改为 use desklamp 或将目标物带到 desklamp 处。

台灯观察.title: 台灯观察：不要依赖 examine 目标物或 examine desklamp 来满足观察条件
台灯观察.principle: examine 目标物通常只返回“There's nothing special about X.”或“Nothing happens.”，examine desklamp 也常无效果；这些动作不能替代“在台灯下观察”的环境成功条件。应优先完成目标物定位、取得/放置、开启台灯等可改变环境状态的动作。
台灯观察.when_to_apply: 当任务要求 look at/examine X under the desklamp，而 examine X 或 examine desklamp 没有产生有效观察结果时。

台灯观察.title: 台灯观察：避免重复 look/examine 同一位置，应继续搜索目标物
台灯观察.principle: 反复执行 look 或 examine 同一桌面/台灯不会改变状态，容易导致 blocked 或 handoff_loop_guard。若当前表面没有目标物，应转向其他容器或家具搜索目标物，找到后再回到 desklamp 处完成观察。
台灯观察.when_to_apply: 在台灯观察任务中，已到达 desklamp 所在位置但目标物不在该表面，且连续 look/examine 没有新信息时。

清洗后放置.title: Clean-then-place workflow for 清洗后放置
清洗后放置.principle: For clean-and-place tasks, first locate and take the target object, then go to a sinkbasin and clean it, then go to the destination receptacle and put it there.
清洗后放置.when_to_apply: When the goal is to put a clean object in a specified location and the object is not already clean.

清洗后放置.title: Do not place an uncleaned object in the destination
清洗后放置.principle: If the goal requires a clean object, placing the object before cleaning it will not satisfy the task and may cause failure.
清洗后放置.when_to_apply: When the task goal explicitly says 'clean' and the object has not yet been cleaned.
清洗后放置.why_it_happens: The agent may skip the cleaning step or attempt to clean after placing, but the environment may not allow cleaning once the object is placed or may mark the task failed.
清洗后放置.how_to_avoid: Always clean the object at a sinkbasin before putting it in the final destination.

清洗后放置.title: Avoid exhaustive search loops when object is not found
清洗后放置.principle: If the target object is not found after checking a reasonable number of locations, do not continue opening every remaining container; instead, reassess or hand off.
清洗后放置.when_to_apply: When searching for an object and many locations have been checked without success.
清洗后放置.why_it_happens: The agent may get stuck in a loop of opening cabinets/drawers, wasting steps and eventually failing due to timeout or supervisor failure.
清洗后放置.how_to_avoid: After checking a few likely locations, consider that the object may be in an unusual place or that the task may be impossible; report blocked or hand off rather than continuing indefinitely.

清洗后放置.title: Do not attempt to clean with non-sinkbasin receptacles
清洗后放置.principle: Cleaning actions only work with a sinkbasin; using other receptacles like bathtubbasin or fridge will fail.
清洗后放置.when_to_apply: When the agent needs to clean an object and is not at a sinkbasin.
清洗后放置.why_it_happens: The agent may try alternative water sources or containers, but the environment only supports cleaning at sinkbasin.
清洗后放置.how_to_avoid: Always navigate to a sinkbasin before issuing a clean action.

加热后放置.title: Search for target object across common containers
加热后放置.principle: When the target object is not in the first searched location, systematically check other likely containers (cabinets, drawers, countertops, fridge, diningtable, sinkbasin, coffeemachine, stoveburners) until the object is found.
加热后放置.when_to_apply: During the search phase of a heat-and-place task when the target object is not immediately visible or is absent from the first checked location.

加热后放置.title: Heat object using microwave
加热后放置.principle: To heat an object, go to the microwave, open it if closed, put the object inside, then use the 'heat <object> with microwave 1' action. If the object is already in the microwave, take it first, then heat it while holding it.
加热后放置.when_to_apply: After acquiring the target object and before placing it at the final destination in a heat-and-place task.

加热后放置.title: Avoid repeated failed heat attempts
加热后放置.principle: If a heat action fails, do not repeat the same action. Instead, verify the object is in the correct location (e.g., inside the microwave) and that you are holding it if required, then try a different heating appliance or adjust the object's position.
加热后放置.why_it_happens: The heat action may fail if the object is not in the correct container, if the container is closed, or if the object is not held when required by the environment.
加热后放置.how_to_avoid: Check the object's location and the container's state before heating. If heating fails, try opening the container, putting the object inside, or using an alternative appliance like a stoveburner.

加热后放置.title: Do not declare failure prematurely when object not in first location
加热后放置.principle: If the target object is not in the first searched location, continue searching other plausible locations instead of declaring the task blocked or failed.
加热后放置.why_it_happens: The object may be in another container or surface that has not yet been checked.
加热后放置.how_to_avoid: Systematically search all likely containers and surfaces before concluding the object is unavailable.

冷却后放置.title: Cooling workflow: locate target, cool with fridge, then place
冷却后放置.principle: For cooling tasks, first find the target object, take it, go to an open fridge, use the cool action with the fridge, then navigate to the final destination and put the object there.
冷却后放置.when_to_apply: When the goal is to cool an object and place it in a specified receptacle.

冷却后放置.title: Do not assume target object is in the fridge
冷却后放置.principle: The fridge is not guaranteed to contain the target object; search other locations such as countertops, cabinets, dining tables, and shelves before concluding the object is unavailable.
冷却后放置.why_it_happens: Agents often check the fridge first because cooling requires a fridge, but the object may be elsewhere.
冷却后放置.how_to_avoid: After checking the fridge, systematically search other common object locations before declaring failure.

冷却后放置.title: Do not hand off after merely opening the fridge
冷却后放置.principle: Opening the fridge is not sufficient for cooling tasks; the agent must locate the target object, take it, cool it, and place it at the destination before handing off.
冷却后放置.why_it_happens: Agents may misinterpret the mission as only opening the fridge or may hand off prematurely after a partial step.
冷却后放置.how_to_avoid: Verify that the full cooling-and-placement sequence is complete before declaring success or handing off.

冷却后放置.title: Do not substitute a different object type for the target
冷却后放置.principle: When the goal specifies a particular object type (e.g., cup, bowl), do not take or use a different but similar object type (e.g., mug) unless the environment explicitly treats them as equivalent.
冷却后放置.why_it_happens: Agents may generalize object categories and pick a nearby similar object.
冷却后放置.how_to_avoid: Match the exact object type requested in the goal; if only a similar type is available, continue searching or report the mismatch.

双物品放置.title: 双物品放置：先放置第一件再取第二件
双物品放置.principle: 在双物品放置任务中，找到第一件目标物品后，先将其放到目标容器，再寻找并取回第二件目标物品，最后将第二件也放到目标容器。
双物品放置.when_to_apply: 当任务要求将两个同类物品放入同一目标容器，且智能体一次只能携带一件物品时。

双物品放置.title: 双物品放置：避免在持有物品时尝试移动或取物
双物品放置.description: 在双物品放置任务中，当智能体已经持有一件物品时，尝试移动到其他位置或取另一件物品通常会失败（返回“Nothing happens”），因为智能体一次只能携带一件物品。
双物品放置.why_it_happens: ALFWorld 环境限制智能体一次只能持有一件物品，持有物品时移动或取物操作会被阻止。
双物品放置.how_to_avoid: 在尝试移动或取第二件物品之前，先将当前持有的物品放到目标容器或临时位置，释放双手后再继续。

双物品放置.title: 双物品放置：搜索时需覆盖多个容器类型
双物品放置.description: 在双物品放置任务中，如果只在一种类型的容器（如仅搜索架子或仅搜索柜子）中寻找目标物品，可能无法找到第二件物品，导致任务失败。
双物品放置.why_it_happens: 目标物品可能分散在不同的容器类型中，如柜台、桌子、架子、柜子等。
双物品放置.how_to_avoid: 系统性地搜索多种类型的容器和表面，包括柜台、桌子、架子、柜子、抽屉等，直到找到两件目标物品。

双物品放置.title: 双物品放置：避免重复声明 HANDOFF 导致循环
双物品放置.description: 在双物品放置任务中，如果智能体在已经持有物品或已完成部分任务时反复声明 HANDOFF 而不执行实际动作，会导致 handoff_loop_guard 终止，任务失败。
双物品放置.why_it_happens: 智能体可能错误地认为当前状态已满足交接条件，但实际任务尚未完成，导致反复声明交接而不推进任务。
双物品放置.how_to_avoid: 仅在确实完成当前子目标（如已取到物品或已放置物品）时声明 HANDOFF，并在声明后继续执行必要的后续动作，避免重复声明。

简单取放.title: Simple pick-and-place execution
简单取放.principle: For simple pick-and-place tasks, locate the target object, take it, navigate to the destination, and put it down.
简单取放.when_to_apply: When the goal is to move a single object to a specified destination and no cleaning, heating, cooling, or lighting is required.

简单取放.title: Open closed containers before placing inside
简单取放.principle: If the destination is a closed container, open it before attempting to put the held object inside.
简单取放.when_to_apply: When the destination is a cabinet, drawer, fridge, microwave, safe, or similar container and the observation indicates it is closed.

简单取放.title: Re-navigate after failed put
简单取放.principle: If a put action returns 'Nothing happens', verify current location and navigate to the destination before retrying the put.
简单取放.why_it_happens: The agent may have attempted to place an object without being at the destination location, causing the put action to fail silently.
简单取放.how_to_avoid: After a failed put, check whether the agent is at the destination; if not, go to the destination and then retry the put.

简单取放.title: Declare failure after exhaustive search
简单取放.principle: If the target object cannot be found after searching relevant locations, declare failure rather than continuing indefinitely.
简单取放.why_it_happens: The object may not exist in the environment or may be in an inaccessible location.
简单取放.how_to_avoid: Search likely containers and surfaces; if the object is not found, report failure.

台灯观察.title: 台灯观察：先定位台灯所在家具，再携带目标物前往
台灯观察.principle: 在台灯观察任务中，不要直接尝试 go to desklamp；台灯是固定在家具上的对象，应先通过探索或已知位置找到承载台灯的家具（如 desk、sidetable、dresser、coffeetable），再携带目标物前往该家具并使用台灯。
台灯观察.when_to_apply: 当目标物已取得或已在手，且需要将其置于台灯下观察时。

台灯观察.title: 台灯观察：到达台灯所在家具后使用台灯完成观察
台灯观察.principle: 携带目标物到达台灯所在家具后，执行 use desklamp 即可完成台灯观察；不需要对目标物执行 examine、use 或 look 来触发观察。
台灯观察.when_to_apply: 当已携带目标物并位于台灯所在家具处，且任务要求 examine/look at 目标物 with/under the desklamp 时。

台灯观察.title: 台灯观察：避免对目标物反复 examine/use/look 而不使用台灯
台灯观察.principle: 在台灯观察任务中，反复对目标物执行 examine、use 或 look 通常不会触发成功条件；成功路径是到达台灯所在家具后使用台灯。若已尝试多次无效，应停止重复并转向寻找/使用台灯。
台灯观察.when_to_apply: 当任务要求 look at/examine 目标物 under/with the desklamp，且对目标物直接 examine/use/look 返回 Nothing happens 或普通描述时。

台灯观察.title: 台灯观察：不要尝试拿起或移动台灯
台灯观察.principle: 台灯是固定对象，take desklamp 或 go to desklamp 通常无效；应把台灯视为家具上的固定交互点，通过前往其所在家具并使用它来完成观察。
台灯观察.when_to_apply: 当任务涉及 desklamp，且尝试 take desklamp 或 go to desklamp 返回 Nothing happens 时。

清洗后放置.title: Clean-then-place sequence for 清洗后放置
清洗后放置.principle: For clean-then-place goals, first acquire the target object, then go to a sinkbasin and clean it, then go to the destination and place it. If the destination is a closed container, open it before placing.
清洗后放置.when_to_apply: When the goal is to put a clean object at a destination and the object is not already clean.

清洗后放置.title: Do not clean with non-sinkbasin fixtures
清洗后放置.principle: Cleaning only works with a sinkbasin. Attempting to clean with a fridge, bathtubbasin, or other fixture produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.
清洗后放置.when_to_apply: When holding an object that needs cleaning and choosing a cleaning location.

清洗后放置.title: Do not place into non-receptacle fixtures
清洗后放置.principle: Some fixtures such as toilets and coffeemachines are not valid placement receptacles. Repeated put attempts produce 'Nothing happens'; if the destination is invalid, report blocked rather than looping.
清洗后放置.when_to_apply: When the destination is a toilet, coffeemachine, or other fixture that rejects placement.

清洗后放置.title: Verify object identity before cleaning
清洗后放置.principle: If the goal specifies a mug but the held object is a cup, cleaning and placing the cup will not satisfy the goal. Confirm the object type matches the goal before proceeding.
清洗后放置.when_to_apply: When the goal names a specific object type and the candidate object may be a different but similar type.

加热后放置.title: Heat held object directly with microwave
加热后放置.principle: When holding the target object and the microwave is open, use the direct heat action instead of placing the object inside first.
加热后放置.when_to_apply: Task type 加热后放置; target object is held; microwave is open; goal requires heating the object.

加热后放置.description: Repeatedly using 'use microwave' or 'heat object with microwave' while the object is inside the microwave can fail without changing state.
加热后放置.why_it_happens: The environment may require the object to be held or the microwave to be open for the heat action to succeed.
加热后放置.how_to_avoid: If heating fails, take the object out, ensure the microwave is open, and try the direct heat action while holding the object.

加热后放置.description: After heating, taking the object from the microwave may fail if the microwave is closed or the object is not inside.
加热后放置.why_it_happens: The take action requires the object to be accessible inside an open microwave.
加热后放置.how_to_avoid: Open the microwave before attempting to take the heated object, and verify the object is inside.

加热后放置.title: Place heated object at destination
加热后放置.principle: After heating and taking the object, go to the destination location and put the object there.
加热后放置.when_to_apply: Task type 加热后放置; object is heated and held; destination is known.

冷却后放置.title: Cool held object with open fridge
冷却后放置.principle: When the goal requires a cooled object, first acquire the object, then navigate to an open fridge while holding it, and use the cool command with the fridge.
冷却后放置.when_to_apply: Holding the target object and standing at an open fridge, with the goal requiring the object to be cool.

冷却后放置.title: Do not cool by placing object in fridge
冷却后放置.principle: Placing an object inside a fridge does not cool it; the cool command must be used while holding the object at the fridge.
冷却后放置.why_it_happens: The environment only changes an object's temperature through the explicit cool action, not through containment.
冷却后放置.how_to_avoid: After reaching the fridge with the object in hand, issue 'cool <object> with fridge' instead of putting the object into the fridge.

冷却后放置.title: Verify destination is open and reachable before placing
冷却后放置.principle: A put action fails silently if the destination is closed or the agent is not at the destination; open the destination and navigate to it before placing.
冷却后放置.why_it_happens: The environment requires the agent to be at an open receptacle to place an object.
冷却后放置.how_to_avoid: After cooling, go to the destination, open it if closed, then put the held object there.

冷却后放置.title: Do not hand off before placing the cooled object
冷却后放置.principle: Cooling the object is not sufficient; the task is complete only after the cooled object is placed at the required destination.
冷却后放置.why_it_happens: The mission goal includes both cooling and placing, so declaring handoff after cooling alone leaves the task incomplete.
冷却后放置.how_to_avoid: After cooling, continue to the destination and place the object before declaring success.

双物品放置.title: Two-item placement: sequential pickup, transport, and placement
双物品放置.principle: For tasks requiring two identical or same-type objects to be placed at a destination, pick up one object, carry it to the destination, place it, then return for the second object and repeat.
双物品放置.when_to_apply: When the goal is to put two objects of the same type at a target location and the agent cannot hold both simultaneously.

双物品放置.title: Open closed containers before placing objects inside
双物品放置.principle: When the destination is a closed container (cabinet, drawer, etc.), open it before attempting to place an object inside.
双物品放置.when_to_apply: When the target destination for placement is a closed container.

双物品放置.title: Avoid repeated failed actions and loops
双物品放置.principle: If an action fails (e.g., 'Nothing happens'), do not repeat it without changing state or approach; reassess and try a different action or location.
双物品放置.why_it_happens: The agent may get stuck repeating the same invalid action, wasting steps and leading to failure or handoff loops.
双物品放置.how_to_avoid: After a failed action, check inventory, location, and object states; try a different action or move to a different location.

双物品放置.title: Verify object type before pickup
双物品放置.principle: Ensure the object being picked up matches the target object type; picking up the wrong object wastes time and may cause task failure.
双物品放置.why_it_happens: The agent may confuse similar objects (e.g., towel vs. handtowel, cloth vs. towel) or misread the observation.
双物品放置.how_to_avoid: Read the observation carefully and confirm the object name matches the goal before taking it.

general.title: Two-phase search-then-operate decomposition
general.principle: For tasks where an object must be acquired and then manipulated or placed, split the mission into a SEARCH MISSION that ends when the target object is in inventory, followed by an OPERATION MISSION that ends when the environment observation confirms the required final state.
general.when_to_apply: When the goal requires an object to be found and then used, cleaned, heated, cooled, examined, or placed, and the object is not already held.

general.title: Search mission return condition: holding the target object
general.principle: Define the SEARCH MISSION return condition as the worker holding the target object, not merely having seen it or opened a container.
general.when_to_apply: When dispatching a worker to find and take an object for any task family.

general.title: Operation mission return condition: environment observation confirms final state
general.principle: Define the OPERATION MISSION return condition as the environment observation confirming the required final state (e.g., object placed at destination, object cleaned, object heated, object cooled), not merely that the worker attempted the action.
general.when_to_apply: When dispatching a worker to manipulate a held object for any task family.

general.title: Avoid repeated identical dispatches after worker failure
general.principle: If a worker returns HANDOFF without achieving the mission's return condition or reports failure, do not re-dispatch the same mission to the same location; change the search location, object description, or strategy.
general.why_it_happens: The supervisor may repeat the same ASSIGN when the worker's failure is not treated as evidence that the current plan is exhausted.
general.how_to_avoid: After a failed or empty search, dispatch the next candidate location or ask the worker to confirm the location is empty before moving on. After repeated 'Nothing happens' for an action, change strategy by verifying object location, opening the appliance, or switching to a different approach.
general.description: If a worker returns HANDOFF without achieving the mission's return condition or reports failure, do not re-dispatch the same mission to the same location; change the search location, object description, or strategy.

general.title: Do not dispatch a search mission for an object at a location that has not been observed to contain it
general.principle: Do not dispatch a search mission that requires finding the object in one specific receptacle unless that receptacle is known to contain it; if the first location fails, broaden the search to other reachable receptacles.
general.why_it_happens: The supervisor may assume the target is in a named container based on the goal template rather than observed environment state, but the environment may place it elsewhere, causing the worker to exhaust the specified location and fail.
general.how_to_avoid: Before dispatching a search mission, require the worker to first report the contents of candidate receptacles, or phrase the mission as 'search cabinets/drawers/countertops for X' rather than binding to a specific unverified location. If the first search returns empty, reassign a broader search instead of repeating the same location.
general.description: Do not dispatch a search mission that requires finding the object in one specific receptacle unless that receptacle is known to contain it; if the first location fails, broaden the search to other reachable receptacles.

general.title: Do not dispatch a placement mission to a closed or non-openable receptacle without first opening it
general.principle: Before dispatching a placement mission, verify the destination is open or can be opened. If the destination is a closed container, prepend an open step. If opening returns 'Nothing happens', treat the receptacle as non-openable and reassign to a valid open destination.
general.why_it_happens: The supervisor assigns an OPERATION MISSION to put an object into a receptacle that is closed or does not support opening. The worker repeatedly attempts 'put' and 'open' with 'Nothing happens' observations, exhausting steps and failing.
general.how_to_avoid: Before dispatching a placement mission, verify the destination is open or can be opened. If the destination is a closed container, prepend an open step. If opening returns 'Nothing happens', treat the receptacle as non-openable and reassign to a valid open destination.
general.description: Before dispatching a placement mission, verify the destination is open or can be opened. If the destination is a closed container, prepend an open step. If opening returns 'Nothing happens', treat the receptacle as non-openable and reassign to a valid open destination.

general.title: Do not declare success or failure based on worker handoff text alone; require environment confirmation of the final state
general.principle: After each OPERATION MISSION handoff, inspect the environment observation for the target object's final state. Only declare success when the observation confirms the goal predicate; only declare failure when the observation shows an invalid/blocked action or the object is unreachable.
general.why_it_happens: The supervisor sometimes declares FAILED after a worker HANDOFF even when the environment events show the object was successfully placed. Conversely, it may accept a handoff without verifying the clean state or final placement.
general.how_to_avoid: After each OPERATION MISSION handoff, inspect the environment observation for the target object's final state (e.g., 'You put the X in/on Y' or 'You clean the X'). Only declare success when the observation confirms the goal predicate; only declare failure when the observation shows an invalid/blocked action or the object is unreachable.
general.description: After each OPERATION MISSION handoff, inspect the environment observation for the target object's final state. Only declare success when the observation confirms the goal predicate; only declare failure when the observation shows an invalid/blocked action or the object is unreachable.

general.title: Do not dispatch placement before the worker holds the object
general.principle: An OPERATION MISSION to put an object at the destination should be dispatched only after the worker has confirmed holding that object; otherwise the placement action will fail or be invalid.
general.why_it_happens: The supervisor may issue a placement mission based on the intended object rather than the worker's actual inventory state.
general.how_to_avoid: Require the worker's HANDOFF to explicitly report holding the target object before assigning the corresponding placement mission.
general.description: An OPERATION MISSION to put an object at the destination should be dispatched only after the worker has confirmed holding that object; otherwise the placement action will fail or be invalid.

台灯观察.title: Use desklamp as a fixed fixture, not a takeable object
台灯观察.principle: In 台灯观察 tasks, the desklamp is typically fixed to its surface. Do not dispatch a mission to take the desklamp; instead, dispatch a mission to go to the desklamp's location and use it (turn it on) while holding the target object.
台灯观察.when_to_apply: When the goal requires examining or looking at an object with/under the desklamp and the desklamp is observed on a desk, sidetable, or dresser.

台灯观察.title: Avoid repeated examine/look loops on the same object
台灯观察.principle: Repeatedly dispatching examine or look missions for the same object after the environment has already returned 'There's nothing special about X' or 'Nothing happens' causes handoff loops and task failure. After one or two failed examine attempts, change strategy: verify object location, try a different interaction (take/put/use), or declare failure.
台灯观察.why_it_happens: The supervisor may not treat a null observation as evidence that the current examine strategy is exhausted.
台灯观察.how_to_avoid: After one or two failed examine attempts, change strategy: verify object location, try a different interaction (take/put/use), or declare failure.
台灯观察.description: Repeatedly dispatching examine or look missions for the same object after the environment has already returned 'There's nothing special about X' or 'Nothing happens' causes handoff loops and task failure. After one or two failed examine attempts, change strategy: verify object location, try a different interaction (take/put/use), or declare failure.

台灯观察.title: Do not assume target object is under the desklamp without verification
台灯观察.principle: The phrase 'under the desklamp' in 台灯观察 goals does not guarantee the target object is physically under the lamp. If the object is not visible at the desklamp location, search other surfaces and containers before declaring failure. Dispatching repeated 'look under desklamp' missions when the object is elsewhere wastes steps and causes failure.
台灯观察.why_it_happens: The supervisor may interpret the goal phrase literally and repeatedly dispatch look missions at the desklamp even when the object is not there.
台灯观察.how_to_avoid: If the object is not visible at the desklamp location, search other surfaces and containers before declaring failure. Dispatching repeated 'look under desklamp' missions when the object is elsewhere wastes steps and causes failure.
台灯观察.description: The phrase 'under the desklamp' in 台灯观察 goals does not guarantee the target object is physically under the lamp. If the object is not visible at the desklamp location, search other surfaces and containers before declaring failure. Dispatching repeated 'look under desklamp' missions when the object is elsewhere wastes steps and causes failure.

清洗后放置.title: Clean-then-place pipeline with explicit clean-state verification
清洗后放置.principle: For 清洗后放置 tasks, decompose into: (1) locate and take the target object, (2) go to a sinkbasin and clean it, (3) verify the clean confirmation in the observation, (4) go to the destination and place it. Do not skip the clean step or assume cleaning succeeded without an explicit 'You clean the X' observation.
清洗后放置.when_to_apply: Any 清洗后放置 goal where the target object may be dirty and the destination is a fixed receptacle.

加热后放置.title: Heat mission after object acquisition
加热后放置.principle: After the worker returns holding the target object, dispatch an OPERATION MISSION to heat it using a heat source such as microwave 1. Return when the environment confirms the object is heated.
加热后放置.when_to_apply: After a successful SEARCH MISSION handoff where the worker holds the target object.

加热后放置.title: Placement mission after heating
加热后放置.principle: After the worker returns with the object heated, dispatch an OPERATION MISSION to place it at the specified destination. Return when the environment confirms the object is at the destination.
加热后放置.when_to_apply: After a successful HEAT MISSION handoff where the object is heated.

冷却后放置.title: Cooling requires a dedicated cool action, not just fridge placement
冷却后放置.principle: For cooling tasks, after obtaining the target object, explicitly perform the cool action with the fridge (e.g., 'cool X with fridge 1') before attempting to place it. Do not assume that putting the object into the fridge and taking it out constitutes cooling.
冷却后放置.when_to_apply: When the goal is to cool an object and place it elsewhere, and the object is currently held.

冷却后放置.title: Verify object identity and coolability before committing to a search
冷却后放置.principle: Before dispatching a search for a specific object, confirm that the object type is present and coolable. If the object is not found after a reasonable search, consider that the task may be impossible and report failure early.
冷却后放置.why_it_happens: The supervisor may assume the object exists without checking, leading to exhaustive searches that waste time and end in failure.
冷却后放置.how_to_avoid: During initial exploration, note the locations of objects. If the target object is not found in likely receptacles, reassess the task feasibility.
冷却后放置.description: Before dispatching a search for a specific object, confirm that the object type is present and coolable. If the object is not found after a reasonable search, consider that the task may be impossible and report failure early.

双物品放置.title: Sequential two-item placement with single-item capacity
双物品放置.principle: For 双物品放置 tasks, treat the mission as two independent search-and-place cycles: locate and take the first target object, place it at the destination, then locate and take the second target object and place it at the destination.
双物品放置.when_to_apply: When the goal requires placing two instances of the same object type at a destination and the worker can hold only one object at a time.

general.title: Search visible surfaces before opening closed containers
general.principle: For object-finding tasks, first scan all visible surfaces (tables, desks, dressers, beds, shelves, countertops, sofas, armchairs, etc.) for the target object before opening closed containers such as drawers, cabinets, safes, fridges, and microwaves.
general.when_to_apply: When the target object is not immediately visible in the current location and the task requires finding it.

general.title: Open closed containers before attempting to take from them
general.principle: When a target object is expected inside a closed container (drawer, cabinet, safe, fridge, microwave), first navigate to the container, then use the open action, then take the object from the opened container.
general.when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible on surfaces and a closed container is a likely location.

general.title: After taking the target object, navigate to the destination and put it there
general.principle: Once the target object is in inventory, go directly to the specified destination receptacle or surface and use the put action to place the object there.
general.when_to_apply: After successfully taking the target object and before declaring handoff or completion.

general.title: Avoid repeated failed actions and declare blocked after exhaustive search
general.principle: If an action such as go to or open returns 'Nothing happens' repeatedly, do not keep retrying the same action. After checking all plausible locations and containers without finding the target object, declare the task blocked rather than looping.
general.when_to_apply: When repeated navigation or open actions fail, or when all known containers and surfaces have been searched without finding the target object.

台灯观察.title: 台灯观察：先定位目标物，再将其带到台灯处并开启台灯
台灯观察.principle: 对于“look at/examine X under the desklamp”类任务，先搜索并取得目标物 X；若目标物不在台灯所在位置，则将其带到有 desklamp 的桌面/台面，放置或保持持有，然后使用 desklamp 开启照明，以完成观察条件。
台灯观察.when_to_apply: 任务目标为观察某物在台灯下，且环境中存在可交互的 desklamp；目标物与 desklamp 不在同一位置，或目标物需要从其他容器/表面取得。

台灯观察.title: 台灯观察：desklamp 通常不可拿取，应使用而非 take
台灯观察.principle: 在台灯观察任务中，desklamp 通常是固定物体，take desklamp 会返回“Nothing happens.”；正确交互是 use desklamp 来开启它，或把目标物放到 desklamp 所在表面后再 use desklamp。
台灯观察.when_to_apply: 需要与 desklamp 交互时；若 take desklamp 失败，不要反复尝试拿取，应改为 use desklamp 或将目标物带到 desklamp 处。

台灯观察.title: 台灯观察：不要依赖 examine 目标物或 examine desklamp 来满足观察条件
台灯观察.principle: examine 目标物通常只返回“There's nothing special about X.”或“Nothing happens.”，examine desklamp 也常无效果；这些动作不能替代“在台灯下观察”的环境成功条件。应优先完成目标物定位、取得/放置、开启台灯等可改变环境状态的动作。
台灯观察.when_to_apply: 当任务要求 look at/examine X under the desklamp，而 examine X 或 examine desklamp 没有产生有效观察结果时。

台灯观察.title: 台灯观察：避免重复 look/examine 同一位置，应继续搜索目标物
台灯观察.principle: 反复执行 look 或 examine 同一桌面/台灯不会改变状态，容易导致 blocked 或 handoff_loop_guard。若当前表面没有目标物，应转向其他容器或家具搜索目标物，找到后再回到 desklamp 处完成观察。
台灯观察.when_to_apply: 在台灯观察任务中，已到达 desklamp 所在位置但目标物不在该表面，且连续 look/examine 没有新信息时。

清洗后放置.title: Clean-then-place workflow for 清洗后放置
清洗后放置.principle: For clean-and-place tasks, first locate and take the target object, then go to a sinkbasin and clean it, then go to the destination receptacle and put it there.
清洗后放置.when_to_apply: When the goal is to put a clean object in a specified location and the object is not already clean.

清洗后放置.title: Do not place an uncleaned object in the destination
清洗后放置.principle: If the goal requires a clean object, placing the object before cleaning it will not satisfy the task and may cause failure.
清洗后放置.when_to_apply: When the task goal explicitly says 'clean' and the object has not yet been cleaned.
清洗后放置.why_it_happens: The agent may skip the cleaning step or attempt to clean after placing, but the environment may not allow cleaning once the object is placed or may mark the task failed.
清洗后放置.how_to_avoid: Always clean the object at a sinkbasin before putting it in the final destination.
清洗后放置.description: If the goal requires a clean object, placing the object before cleaning it will not satisfy the task and may cause failure.

清洗后放置.title: Avoid exhaustive search loops when object is not found
清洗后放置.principle: If the target object is not found after checking a reasonable number of locations, do not continue opening every remaining container; instead, reassess or hand off.
清洗后放置.when_to_apply: When searching for an object and many locations have been checked without success.
清洗后放置.why_it_happens: The agent may get stuck in a loop of opening cabinets/drawers, wasting steps and eventually failing due to timeout or supervisor failure.
清洗后放置.how_to_avoid: After checking a few likely locations, consider that the object may be in an unusual place or that the task may be impossible; report blocked or hand off rather than continuing indefinitely.
清洗后放置.description: If the target object is not found after checking a reasonable number of locations, do not continue opening every remaining container; instead, reassess or hand off.

清洗后放置.title: Do not attempt to clean with non-sinkbasin receptacles
清洗后放置.principle: Cleaning actions only work with a sinkbasin; using other receptacles like bathtubbasin or fridge will fail.
清洗后放置.when_to_apply: When the agent needs to clean an object and is not at a sinkbasin.
清洗后放置.why_it_happens: The agent may try alternative water sources or containers, but the environment only supports cleaning at sinkbasin.
清洗后放置.how_to_avoid: Always navigate to a sinkbasin before issuing a clean action.
清洗后放置.description: Cleaning actions only work with a sinkbasin; using other receptacles like bathtubbasin or fridge will fail.

加热后放置.title: Search for target object across common containers
加热后放置.principle: When the target object is not in the first searched location, systematically check other likely containers (cabinets, drawers, countertops, fridge, diningtable, sinkbasin, coffeemachine, stoveburners) until the object is found.
加热后放置.when_to_apply: During the search phase of a heat-and-place task when the target object is not immediately visible or is absent from the first checked location.

加热后放置.title: Heat object using microwave
加热后放置.principle: To heat an object, go to the microwave, open it if closed, put the object inside, then use the 'heat <object> with microwave 1' action. If the object is already in the microwave, take it first, then heat it while holding it.
加热后放置.when_to_apply: After acquiring the target object and before placing it at the final destination in a heat-and-place task.

加热后放置.title: Avoid repeated failed heat attempts
加热后放置.principle: If a heat action fails, do not repeat the same action. Instead, verify the object is in the correct location (e.g., inside the microwave) and that you are holding it if required, then try a different heating appliance or adjust the object's position.
加热后放置.when_to_apply: When a heat action returns failure or 'Nothing happens'.
加热后放置.why_it_happens: The heat action may fail if the object is not in the correct container, if the container is closed, or if the object is not held when required by the environment.
加热后放置.how_to_avoid: Check the object's location and the container's state before heating. If heating fails, try opening the container, putting the object inside, or using an alternative appliance like a stoveburner.
加热后放置.description: If a heat action fails, do not repeat the same action. Instead, verify the object is in the correct location (e.g., inside the microwave) and that you are holding it if required, then try a different heating appliance or adjust the object's position.

加热后放置.title: Do not declare failure prematurely when object not in first location
加热后放置.principle: If the target object is not in the first searched location, continue searching other plausible locations instead of declaring the task blocked or failed.
加热后放置.when_to_apply: When the target object is not found in the first location checked during a heat-and-place task.
加热后放置.why_it_happens: The object may be in another container or surface that has not yet been checked.
加热后放置.how_to_avoid: Systematically search all likely containers and surfaces before concluding the object is unavailable.
加热后放置.description: If the target object is not in the first searched location, continue searching other plausible locations instead of declaring the task blocked or failed.

冷却后放置.title: Cooling workflow: locate target, cool with fridge, then place
冷却后放置.principle: For cooling tasks, first find the target object, take it, go to an open fridge, use the cool action with the fridge, then navigate to the final destination and put the object there.
冷却后放置.when_to_apply: When the goal is to cool an object and place it in a specified receptacle.

冷却后放置.title: Do not assume target object is in the fridge
冷却后放置.principle: The fridge is not guaranteed to contain the target object; search other locations such as countertops, cabinets, dining tables, and shelves before concluding the object is unavailable.
冷却后放置.when_to_apply: When searching for the target object in a cooling task.
冷却后放置.why_it_happens: Agents often check the fridge first because cooling requires a fridge, but the object may be elsewhere.
冷却后放置.how_to_avoid: After checking the fridge, systematically search other common object locations before declaring failure.
冷却后放置.description: The fridge is not guaranteed to contain the target object; search other locations such as countertops, cabinets, dining tables, and shelves before concluding the object is unavailable.

冷却后放置.title: Do not hand off after merely opening the fridge
冷却后放置.principle: Opening the fridge is not sufficient for cooling tasks; the agent must locate the target object, take it, cool it, and place it at the destination before handing off.
冷却后放置.when_to_apply: During a cooling task after opening the fridge but before completing the full sequence.
冷却后放置.why_it_happens: Agents may misinterpret the mission as only opening the fridge or may hand off prematurely after a partial step.
冷却后放置.how_to_avoid: Verify that the full cooling-and-placement sequence is complete before declaring success or handing off.
冷却后放置.description: Opening the fridge is not sufficient for cooling tasks; the agent must locate the target object, take it, cool it, and place it at the destination before handing off.

冷却后放置.title: Do not substitute a different object type for the target
冷却后放置.principle: When the goal specifies a particular object type (e.g., cup, bowl), do not take or use a different but similar object type (e.g., mug) unless the environment explicitly treats them as equivalent.
冷却后放置.when_to_apply: When searching for and selecting the target object in a cooling task.
冷却后放置.why_it_happens: Agents may generalize object categories and pick a nearby similar object.
冷却后放置.how_to_avoid: Match the exact object type requested in the goal; if only a similar type is available, continue searching or report the mismatch.
冷却后放置.description: When the goal specifies a particular object type (e.g., cup, bowl), do not take or use a different but similar object type (e.g., mug) unless the environment explicitly treats them as equivalent.

双物品放置.title: 双物品放置：先放置第一件再取第二件
双物品放置.principle: 在双物品放置任务中，找到第一件目标物品后，先将其放到目标容器，再寻找并取回第二件目标物品，最后将第二件也放到目标容器。
双物品放置.when_to_apply: 当任务要求将两个同类物品放入同一目标容器，且智能体一次只能携带一件物品时。

双物品放置.title: 双物品放置：避免在持有物品时尝试移动或取物
双物品放置.principle: 在双物品放置任务中，当智能体已经持有一件物品时，尝试移动到其他位置或取另一件物品通常会失败（返回“Nothing happens”），因为智能体一次只能携带一件物品。
双物品放置.when_to_apply: 当智能体已持有一件物品并尝试移动或取第二件物品时。
双物品放置.why_it_happens: ALFWorld 环境限制智能体一次只能持有一件物品，持有物品时移动或取物操作会被阻止。
双物品放置.how_to_avoid: 在尝试移动或取第二件物品之前，先将当前持有的物品放到目标容器或临时位置，释放双手后再继续。
双物品放置.description: 在双物品放置任务中，当智能体已经持有一件物品时，尝试移动到其他位置或取另一件物品通常会失败（返回“Nothing happens”），因为智能体一次只能携带一件物品。

双物品放置.title: 双物品放置：搜索时需覆盖多个容器类型
双物品放置.principle: 在双物品放置任务中，如果只在一种类型的容器（如仅搜索架子或仅搜索柜子）中寻找目标物品，可能无法找到第二件物品，导致任务失败。
双物品放置.when_to_apply: 在双物品放置任务中搜索第二件目标物品时。
双物品放置.why_it_happens: 目标物品可能分散在不同的容器类型中，如柜台、桌子、架子、柜子等。
双物品放置.how_to_avoid: 系统性地搜索多种类型的容器和表面，包括柜台、桌子、架子、柜子、抽屉等，直到找到两件目标物品。
双物品放置.description: 在双物品放置任务中，如果只在一种类型的容器（如仅搜索架子或仅搜索柜子）中寻找目标物品，可能无法找到第二件物品，导致任务失败。

双物品放置.title: 双物品放置：避免重复声明 HANDOFF 导致循环
双物品放置.principle: 在双物品放置任务中，如果智能体在已经持有物品或已完成部分任务时反复声明 HANDOFF 而不执行实际动作，会导致 handoff_loop_guard 终止，任务失败。
双物品放置.when_to_apply: 在双物品放置任务中，当智能体考虑声明 HANDOFF 时。
双物品放置.why_it_happens: 智能体可能错误地认为当前状态已满足交接条件，但实际任务尚未完成，导致反复声明交接而不推进任务。
双物品放置.how_to_avoid: 仅在确实完成当前子目标（如已取到物品或已放置物品）时声明 HANDOFF，并在声明后继续执行必要的后续动作，避免重复声明。
双物品放置.description: 在双物品放置任务中，如果智能体在已经持有物品或已完成部分任务时反复声明 HANDOFF 而不执行实际动作，会导致 handoff_loop_guard 终止，任务失败。

general.title: Open closed containers before placing inside
general.principle: If the destination is a closed container, open it before attempting to put the held object inside.
general.when_to_apply: When the destination is a cabinet, drawer, fridge, microwave, safe, or similar container and the observation indicates it is closed.

general.title: Re-navigate after failed put
general.principle: If a put action returns 'Nothing happens', verify current location and navigate to the destination before retrying the put.
general.why_it_happens: The agent may have attempted to place an object without being at the destination location, causing the put action to fail silently.
general.how_to_avoid: After a failed put, check whether the agent is at the destination; if not, go to the destination and then retry the put.
general.description: If a put action returns 'Nothing happens', verify current location and navigate to the destination before retrying the put.

general.title: Avoid repeated failed actions and loops
general.principle: If an action fails (e.g., 'Nothing happens'), do not repeat it without changing state or approach; reassess and try a different action or location.
general.why_it_happens: The agent may get stuck repeating the same invalid action, wasting steps and leading to failure or handoff loops.
general.how_to_avoid: After a failed action, check inventory, location, and object states; try a different action or move to a different location.
general.description: If an action fails (e.g., 'Nothing happens'), do not repeat it without changing state or approach; reassess and try a different action or location.

general.title: Verify object identity before pickup or transformation
general.principle: Ensure the object being picked up or transformed matches the target object type; similar but different objects (e.g., cup vs. mug, towel vs. handtowel) will not satisfy the goal.
general.why_it_happens: The agent may confuse similar objects or misread the observation, wasting time and causing task failure.
general.how_to_avoid: Read the observation carefully and confirm the object name matches the goal before taking or transforming it.
general.description: Ensure the object being picked up or transformed matches the target object type; similar but different objects (e.g., cup vs. mug, towel vs. handtowel) will not satisfy the goal.

general.title: Declare failure after exhaustive search
general.principle: If the target object cannot be found after searching relevant locations, declare failure rather than continuing indefinitely.
general.why_it_happens: The object may not exist in the environment or may be in an inaccessible location.
general.how_to_avoid: Search likely containers and surfaces; if the object is not found, report failure.
general.description: If the target object cannot be found after searching relevant locations, declare failure rather than continuing indefinitely.

简单取放.title: Simple pick-and-place execution
简单取放.principle: For simple pick-and-place tasks, locate the target object, take it, navigate to the destination, and put it down.
简单取放.when_to_apply: When the goal is to move a single object to a specified destination and no cleaning, heating, cooling, or lighting is required.

台灯观察.title: 台灯观察：先定位台灯所在家具，再携带目标物前往
台灯观察.principle: 在台灯观察任务中，不要直接尝试 go to desklamp；台灯是固定在家具上的对象，应先通过探索或已知位置找到承载台灯的家具（如 desk、sidetable、dresser、coffeetable），再携带目标物前往该家具并使用台灯。
台灯观察.when_to_apply: 当目标物已取得或已在手，且需要将其置于台灯下观察时。

台灯观察.title: 台灯观察：到达台灯所在家具后使用台灯完成观察
台灯观察.principle: 携带目标物到达台灯所在家具后，执行 use desklamp 即可完成台灯观察；不需要对目标物执行 examine、use 或 look 来触发观察。
台灯观察.when_to_apply: 当已携带目标物并位于台灯所在家具处，且任务要求 examine/look at 目标物 with/under the desklamp 时。

台灯观察.title: 台灯观察：避免对目标物反复 examine/use/look 而不使用台灯
台灯观察.principle: 在台灯观察任务中，反复对目标物执行 examine、use 或 look 通常不会触发成功条件；成功路径是到达台灯所在家具后使用台灯。若已尝试多次无效，应停止重复并转向寻找/使用台灯。
台灯观察.when_to_apply: 当任务要求 look at/examine 目标物 under/with the desklamp，且对目标物直接 examine/use/look 返回 Nothing happens 或普通描述时。

台灯观察.title: 台灯观察：不要尝试拿起或移动台灯
台灯观察.principle: 台灯是固定对象，take desklamp 或 go to desklamp 通常无效；应把台灯视为家具上的固定交互点，通过前往其所在家具并使用它来完成观察。
台灯观察.when_to_apply: 当任务涉及 desklamp，且尝试 take desklamp 或 go to desklamp 返回 Nothing happens 时。

清洗后放置.title: Clean-then-place sequence for 清洗后放置
清洗后放置.principle: For clean-then-place goals, first acquire the target object, then go to a sinkbasin and clean it, then go to the destination and place it. If the destination is a closed container, open it before placing.
清洗后放置.when_to_apply: When the goal is to put a clean object at a destination and the object is not already clean.

清洗后放置.title: Do not clean with non-sinkbasin fixtures
清洗后放置.principle: Cleaning only works with a sinkbasin. Attempting to clean with a fridge, bathtubbasin, or other fixture produces 'Nothing happens' and wastes steps.
清洗后放置.when_to_apply: When holding an object that needs cleaning and choosing a cleaning location.

清洗后放置.title: Do not place into non-receptacle fixtures
清洗后放置.principle: Some fixtures such as toilets and coffeemachines are not valid placement receptacles. Repeated put attempts produce 'Nothing happens'; if the destination is invalid, report blocked rather than looping.
清洗后放置.when_to_apply: When the destination is a toilet, coffeemachine, or other fixture that rejects placement.

加热后放置.title: Heat held object directly with microwave
加热后放置.principle: When holding the target object and the microwave is open, use the direct heat action instead of placing the object inside first.
加热后放置.when_to_apply: Task type 加热后放置; target object is held; microwave is open; goal requires heating the object.

加热后放置.title: Avoid repeated failed heating inside microwave
加热后放置.principle: Repeatedly using 'use microwave' or 'heat object with microwave' while the object is inside the microwave can fail without changing state.
加热后放置.why_it_happens: The environment may require the object to be held or the microwave to be open for the heat action to succeed.
加热后放置.how_to_avoid: If heating fails, take the object out, ensure the microwave is open, and try the direct heat action while holding the object.
加热后放置.description: Repeatedly using 'use microwave' or 'heat object with microwave' while the object is inside the microwave can fail without changing state.

加热后放置.title: Open microwave before taking heated object
加热后放置.principle: After heating, taking the object from the microwave may fail if the microwave is closed or the object is not inside.
加热后放置.why_it_happens: The take action requires the object to be accessible inside an open microwave.
加热后放置.how_to_avoid: Open the microwave before attempting to take the heated object, and verify the object is inside.
加热后放置.description: After heating, taking the object from the microwave may fail if the microwave is closed or the object is not inside.

加热后放置.title: Place heated object at destination
加热后放置.principle: After heating and taking the object, go to the destination location and put the object there.
加热后放置.when_to_apply: Task type 加热后放置; object is heated and held; destination is known.

冷却后放置.title: Cool held object with open fridge
冷却后放置.principle: When the goal requires a cooled object, first acquire the object, then navigate to an open fridge while holding it, and use the cool command with the fridge.
冷却后放置.when_to_apply: Holding the target object and standing at an open fridge, with the goal requiring the object to be cool.

冷却后放置.title: Do not cool by placing object in fridge
冷却后放置.principle: Placing an object inside a fridge does not cool it; the cool command must be used while holding the object at the fridge.
冷却后放置.why_it_happens: The environment only changes an object's temperature through the explicit cool action, not through containment.
冷却后放置.how_to_avoid: After reaching the fridge with the object in hand, issue 'cool <object> with fridge' instead of putting the object into the fridge.
冷却后放置.description: Placing an object inside a fridge does not cool it; the cool command must be used while holding the object at the fridge.

冷却后放置.title: Verify destination is open and reachable before placing
冷却后放置.principle: A put action fails silently if the destination is closed or the agent is not at the destination; open the destination and navigate to it before placing.
冷却后放置.why_it_happens: The environment requires the agent to be at an open receptacle to place an object.
冷却后放置.how_to_avoid: After cooling, go to the destination, open it if closed, then put the held object there.
冷却后放置.description: A put action fails silently if the destination is closed or the agent is not at the destination; open the destination and navigate to it before placing.

冷却后放置.title: Do not hand off before placing the cooled object
冷却后放置.principle: Cooling the object is not sufficient; the task is complete only after the cooled object is placed at the required destination.
冷却后放置.why_it_happens: The mission goal includes both cooling and placing, so declaring handoff after cooling alone leaves the task incomplete.
冷却后放置.how_to_avoid: After cooling, continue to the destination and place the object before declaring success.
冷却后放置.description: Cooling the object is not sufficient; the task is complete only after the cooled object is placed at the required destination.

双物品放置.title: Two-item placement: sequential pickup, transport, and placement
双物品放置.principle: For tasks requiring two identical or same-type objects to be placed at a destination, pick up one object, carry it to the destination, place it, then return for the second object and repeat.
双物品放置.when_to_apply: When the goal is to put two objects of the same type at a target location and the agent cannot hold both simultaneously.
